I haven't got time for a book. A song's three and a half minutes.

Especially when you get to Spain.
I said when we get there let’s see if there’s any donkeys on the beach.
Right? And she didn’t like that, so…
Oh, what? The joke about hoping she died?

I couldn't care that people were staring at me. I was rolling about on the floor, like a dying fly, on me back. I just didn't care about what was going on around me, but I was told that because it's busy that they might have to send…

q: Why didn't Karl fancy a trip into space with Virgin Galactic?

What, you mean to do some duty free shopping?

Well, they probably let you move around on the shuttle.

Wait, you wanna get out into space?

Yes, but that's what I'm saying. When you go on holiday, the flight bit isn't the best bit of the holiday, is it? That's the bit you've got to do. So what I'm saying is you've got to stay on this and then you go back home. So you don't…

ex: And he had the head of a little-- was it a little boy or a man?
And he's just bumping into a lamp.

If I was in the area.
He's the best. He's great, isn't he? I'd love, I'd love a queue, right?

Well yeah, I just think they've gotta - it's not for us to say whether we need them or not... We can't -
So you think we should keep them?

One near Knightsbridge, they've got a nice selection, some old vases and stuff, it's worth going, so...

It can't fly after a big meal

Do you know that a pelican, I read the other day, that is has to turn its head upside down to eat.

“I'll just take these out and then I can wash your head.”

q: Karl imagined God telling a rich girl with fat ankles: "you can have all the ___ and stuff you want... but you're stuck with these ankles." All the what?

ex: And they drive up her the wall, cos no matter, I mean it's one of them things innit, it's almost like god has gone, “yeah you can have all the toffees and stuff you want, you can have like your nice t-shirts, but at the end of the day…
I love the idea of God saying “right, you can have all the toffees you want, and you have nice handbags and that, but you're stuck with these ankles.” 'Oh! God.'

q: Karl asked medical student Rob why he couldn't skip the finger and go straight to the other tests. What did he call this?

ex: But Rob, right, you said then, if they find something they send me off for some test, why can't I just have the test without that and cut out the middleman?
Because you're wasting lots of money.

There's hundreds of tests they could do, they could do every test and they could all come back with nothing or they could do the finger up there and send you for the three tests you need to find out what's wrong with you.

q: Why did Karl reckon fish have more rights than us?
a: Rights come in numbers, and there are loads of fish

Nobody's ever seen a fish start a war
f: Steve: "But they're not really making their voices heard, though, are they, Karl?" Karl: "I know. Cause they're underwater."
ex: But why does that mean they've got more rights than us?

Just because I think what- you know, rights come in numbers, don't they? If you know what I mean. Like, if there's one of you shouting, people go: "Oh, he's an idiot. Shut up." Whatever. If there's loads of you shouting, they go: "Oh, best…
And that's what I mean about fish.

q: Why did Karl want to add his new sound-effects music round to Rockbusters?

To give away twice as many prizes
So he wouldn't have to write any more clues

ex: Right, how about right,we've got this other- other thing- right this other music thing. How about we make that part of it?
How many competitions have you got?

No, well this is what i'm thinking right, because we can- if you're not happy with Rockbusters. If we add a little bit to it, and they love the bit I've added. Then we can slowly fade it out without them knowing.
That's it, do two of your Rockbusters and one of these.

ex: Yeah, of course it does. And you look like the, uh, humanzee.
I mean, to be honest you did, a bit, Karl. You walk like him, you're bald like him...
You've got a, sort of, gormless face like him. Any more?!

He gets too fat to fit through his door

You should’ve partied hard, 'cause you might die!
Yeah. Yeah. Enjoy life whilst you’ve got it.
Yeah. And if winter comes, just starve to death!
Well, you know. Worry about tomorrow tomorrow.

(In West Country accent) Learnt on a tractor, automatic it was.

It was on, it was on Wednesday night, I was watching, see the problem is I didn't get the full story, so you could pick holes out of it...
Unlike your usual investigations into the supernatural.

Yeah but for the good. He went in and sort of said..

Evolved mammal that re entered the, the water, I imagine, and then got streamline and I mean, it's between a fish and a dog, but why not have.

Having lunch around 4am you go into
Butty shops now that butty's probably been made about four hours ago.

Our memory is always sort of like coming in for some orange and looking at the telly, seeing Princess Diana's getting married, and me mum says "Have you seen this?" And going "No, I'm going out on me bike." I was always doing that.

Raced it down the street to show his mates

There’s only this. A letter for Ms. Harris.

No, it’s my address! She doesn’t live there.

Circus strongmen selling their tug-of-war rope
